description: [Approved mode — write] This tool creates a record in Pushizo. It only creates a DRAFT and never sends or schedules a message; the API key needs the `mcp:write` scope. Get explicit approval from the user before calling it. Creates a campaign in `draft` status. Audience is given as segment IDs; content inline or via template_id. Example content: {"headings":{"en":"Title"},"contents":{"en":"Body"}}. Run run_campaign_preflight on the draft to audit it before a person sends it.

app_id.description: App ID (app_…). Not needed with an app-scoped key or when a default app is configured.

included_segments.description: Included segments; empty means all subscribers.

name: create_campaign_draft
title: Create campaign draft
